messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":10,"verses":[{"chapter":10,"verse":16,"text":"For he has loved the beauty of the serpent and the scales (skins) of the dracon his gall and his venom belongs to the Northern One (Zphuni = Adder)."},{"chapter":10,"verse":17,"text":"For he did not own himself unto the Lord nor did he fear him, but he hated those whom He hath chosen (known)."},{"chapter":10,"verse":18,"text":"Thus God forgot him, and \"the holy ones\" forsook him, his wrath and anger shall be unto him desolation and he will have no mercy in his heart nor peace, because he, had the venom of an adder on his tongue."},{"chapter":10,"verse":19,"text":"Righteous is the Lord, and His judgments are true, With him there is no preference of person, for He judgeth all alike."},{"chapter":10,"verse":20,"text":"Behold, the Lord cometh! Behold, the \"holy ones\" have been prepared: The crowns and the prizes of the victors precede them!"}],"book_code":"TJOB"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 16,17,18,19,20 in this chapter.
